description: Operator-owned obligations for FOREIGN targets - repos with no assurance plane of their own. Universal classes only: CI/supply chain, agent configuration, and dependency manifests. Lives beside the profiles, outside every target, so a candidate can never supply or edit the policy that judges it.

obligations.obligation: CI_OR_SUPPLY_CHAIN_MODIFIED: this change edits CI configuration, which decides what is executed on a runner and with which credentials. A change here can defang the gate and still read as green, so it needs INDEPENDENT human review and is never an autonomous edit.

AGENT_CONFIG_MODIFIED: this change edits the instructions or configuration that future agent sessions load. An agent editing its own standing instructions is self-modification and needs INDEPENDENT human review.
DEPENDENCY_MANIFEST_MODIFIED: this change alters what code is fetched and executed at build or install time - a supply-chain surface. It needs INDEPENDENT human review.
